title: Etale morphisms of algebraic spaces are locally quasi-finite
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $E$ be an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $f:E\to T$ be a morphism to a scheme $T$ over $S$. Assume that $f$ is etale in the chartwise sense: for every representable etale morphism $V\to E$ with $V$ a scheme, the composite $V\to T$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Then $f$ is locally quasi-finite in the chartwise sense: for every such $V\to E$, the composite $V\to T$ is locally quasi-finite [pqf-def-quasifinite].
